svg.title: Textile worker — Man
svg.desc: A fictional man working as textile worker, wearing an apron. Visible work cue: A sewing needle has an elongated eye and one long shaft, threaded with a loose looping strand. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Appearance: short curls, a softly squared face.
